formattedAddress: No. 67號, Luoyang St, Fuxing Village, Wanhua District, Taipei City, Taiwan 108

text.text:
Arrived around 7:00PM and got in right away. We all ordered individual beef noodle soup and dumplings to share. I ordered a large and i couldn't finish all the noodles. The noodles had a nice al dente chewiness to them. The beef was nice and tender. I've had richer more complex broths but it was still good.

The plump dumplings were freshly boiled and arrived hot.

The noodles and dumplings are a great  value.

text.text: This beef noodle shop offers great value. The beef is served in large, tender chunks that are easy to eat, and the noodles have a nice chewy texture. The broth is flavorful and aromatic without being overpowering. A big plus is the efficient seating system—there’s usually no queue, and the food comes out fast. It’s a casual local spot with quick service. They also provide chili butter and pickled greens for self-service. Great choice for a quick, tasty, and affordable meal.

text.text: Fuhong Beef Noodle is the definition of a true local gem in Taipei. The place is small, very run-down and clearly not designed for tourists — everyone inside was local, which is usually the best sign. I had their Taiwanese beef noodle soup and it was outstanding: deep, rich broth, perfectly cooked noodles and incredibly flavorful beef. I was told this place was something special, and that turned out to be absolutely true. No frills, no pretension — just seriously good food.

text.text:
Well cooked beef noodles. The beef pieces were lean and tender - very juicy and flavourful. The noodles were cooked just right. The soup stock was also great. This combination made me give this shop 5 stars.

They also sell century eggs and tofu on the side. It complements the beef noodles. You can ask for more soup stock.

The toilet is behind the shop and is clean.

Highly recommended. Thumbs up! I will be back for more!

text.text: Fuhong Beef Noodles — I really love their thick flat noodles, perfectly chewy and satisfying! The beef is super tender, flavorful, and melts in your mouth. The soup is rich and comforting, great balance of taste without being too oily. Portion is generous and worth the price. Busy during meal times but service is quick. A must-try spot for beef noodle lovers in Taipei!
